name: desktop-picker-open-states
goal: Show opened revision and project lists, a named empty project choice and visible project loading

evidence: Visual6 rejects closed native selects inside opened picker dialogs, blank empty choices and invisible project loading. Keep fixture project names and roots meaningful.
Existing cases proved dialogs and selected values but not painted option lists, empty labels or busy status. Strengthen the same18 affected viewport cases; preserve the existing state count.
